mentions.name: Pyxis
mentions.description: Pyxis is an iOS travel journal app for saving favorite locations. It lets users add notes and photos to saved places, check weather, tag locations for organization, archive tags for future trips, and mark off visited spots like breweries or coffee shops when visiting a new city. Planned updates include per-location task lists (inspired by shopping lists) and historical weather averages shown alongside forecasts, plus a new icon with custom artwork.
